explication: Mbed TLS is a C library for X.509 certificate processing and TLS/DTLS secure channels, backed by PSA cryptography. The principal workflow is an application configuring a client or server, opening transport, performing a TLS/DTLS handshake, validating certificates and deriving keys, then exchanging protected records. X.509 utilities provide a separate certificate/CSR/CRL workflow. The graph reflects sampled client, TLS 1.2/1.3, DTLS, socket, certificate, cache and ticket code; unsampled server details are represented only where the tree supports them.
